The First Edition of the Work has long been out of print, and the Second would have been published earlier, only that an expected change in the designation of the corps delayed its appearance. That change having occurred, the volumes are republished, recording the services of the corps to the date it continued to bear its old title.

6217-the-pomp-of-the-lavilettes-complete.description: A book by Gilbert Parker. It is a satisfaction to include this book in a definitive edition of my works, for I think that, so far as it goes, it is truthfully characteristic of French life in Canada, that its pictures are faithful, and that the character-drawing represents a closer observation than any of the previous works, slight as the volume is.

arxiv-1710-08453.title: Singular Geometry and Higgs Bundles in String Theory
arxiv-1710-08453.creator: Lara B. ANDERSON † 1 {}^{{\dagger}^{1}}, Mboyo ESOLE † 2 {}^{{\dagger}^{2}}, Laura FREDRICKSON † 3 {}^{{\dagger}^{3}} and Laura P. SCHAPOSNIK † 4 † 5 {}^{{\dagger}^{4}{\dagger}^{5}}
arxiv-1710-08453.description: Abstract This brief survey aims to set the stage and summarize some of the ideas under discussion at the Workshop on Singular Geometry and Higgs Bundles in String Theory , to be held at the American Institute of Mathematics from October 30th to November 3rd, 2017.

arxiv-2204-01710.title: Convolutional Neural Networks for Image Spam Detection
arxiv-2204-01710.creator: Tazmina Sharmin Fabio Di Troia Katerina Potika Mark Stamp
arxiv-2204-01710.description: Abstract Spam can be defined as unsolicited bulk email. In an effort to evade text-based filters, spammers sometimes embed spam text in an image, which is referred to as image spam. In this research, we consider the problem of image spam detection, based on image analysis.

arxiv-2212-06729.title: Γ \Gamma –convergence for nearly incompressible fluids
arxiv-2212-06729.creator: Peter Bella, Eduard Feireisl, Florian Oschmann
arxiv-2212-06729.description: Abstract We consider the time-dependent compressible Navier–Stokes equations in the low Mach number regime in a family of domains Ω ε ⊂ R d \Omega_{\varepsilon}\subset R^{d} converging in the sense of Mosco to a domain Ω ⊂ R d \Omega\subset R^{d} , d ∈ { 2 , 3 } d\in\{2,3\} .

arxiv-2402-06162.title: Wasserstein proximal operators describe score-based generative models and resolve memorization
arxiv-2402-06162.creator: Benjamin J. Zhang, Siting Liu, Wuchen Li, Markos A. Katsoulakis, Stanley J. Osher
arxiv-2402-06162.description: Abstract We focus on the fundamental mathematical structure of score-based generative models (SGMs). We first formulate SGMs in terms of the Wasserstein proximal operator (WPO) and demonstrate that, via mean-field games (MFGs), the WPO formulation reveals mathematical structure that describes the inductive bias of diffusion and score-based models.

arxiv-2409-11477.title: Quark mass dependence of doubly heavy tetraquark binding
arxiv-2409-11477.creator: K. Maltman
arxiv-2409-11477.description: Abstract The existence of bound doubly heavy tetraquark states was confirmed by the recent LHCb discovery of the doubly charmed T c ​ c T_{cc} , less than 1 MeV below the meson pair threshold. Others states with two heavy (bottom or charm) quarks could also be bound, perhaps more deeply.

arxiv-2512-05921.title: Thermodynamics of Shear Equilibration During Magnetic Reconnection Onset in Mixed-Equilibrium Current Sheets
arxiv-2512-05921.description: Abstract Magnetic shear across the polarity inversion line (PIL) plays an important role in the explosive nature of reconnection onset and in the equilibration of current sheets, acting as a source of free energy that can enhance or inhibit the onset process under certain conditions.

arxiv-2605-29278.creator: Terra Blevins

plos-pone-0012561.description: PLOS ONE research article. Many hundreds of botanicals are used in complementary and alternative medicine for therapeutic use as antimicrobials and immune stimulators. While there exists many centuries of anecdotal evidence and few clinical studies on the activity and efficacy of these botanicals, limited

pmc-11390826.title: Prevalence of Paid Sex and Associated Factors Among Women and Men Attending HIV Voluntary Counseling and Testing in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo: A Prospective Cohort
pmc-11390826.creator: Silvia Carlos, Gabriel Reina, Eduardo Burgueño, Benit Makonda, Jokin de Irala, Carlos Beltramo, Paula Díaz Herráez, Cristina Lopez-del Burgo
pmc-11390826.description: Paid sex is associated with HIV and other sexually transmitted infections, which are highly prevalent in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). However, few data exist on this sexual practice among the general population in SSA, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where data on paid sex mainly comes from sex workers.

pmc-11436643.title: Rapid context inference in a thalamocortical model using recurrent neural networks
pmc-11436643.creator: Wei-Long Zheng, Zhongxuan Wu, Ali Hummos, Guangyu Robert Yang, Michael M. Halassa
pmc-11436643.description: Cognitive flexibility is a fundamental ability that enables humans and animals to exhibit appropriate behaviors in various contexts. The thalamocortical interactions between the prefrontal cortex (PFC) and the mediodorsal thalamus (MD) have been identified as crucial for inferring temporal context, a critical component of cognitive flexibility. However, the neural mechanism responsible for context inference remains unknown.

pmc-11509589.title: Mechanical Property of Thermoplastic Polyurethane Vascular Stents Fabricated by Fused Filament Fabrication
pmc-11509589.creator: Yun Zhai, Zezhi Sun, Tie Zhang, Changchun Zhou, Xiangpeng Kong, Nam-Trung Nguyen, Gokhan Bahcecioglu, Bradley Ellis, Gozde Basara
pmc-11509589.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Vascular stents have many applications in treating arterial stenosis and other vascular-related diseases. The ideal vascular stent for clinical application should have radial support and axial bending mechanical properties that meet the requirements of vascular deformation coordination. The materials used for vascular stents implanted in the human body should have corresponding biocompatibility to ensure that the stents do not cause coagulation, hemolysis, and other reactions in the blood.

pmc-11618357.title: Optimizing tilt angle of PV modules for different locations using isotropic and anisotropic models to maximize power output
pmc-11618357.creator: Muhammad Tamoor, Abdul Rauf Bhatti, Muhammad Farhan, Akhtar Rasool, Abdulkerim Sherefa
pmc-11618357.description: The optimal integration of Photovoltaic (PV) systems into an electric grid is dependent upon the total output power of the PV system. To optimize the output power of a PV system, the modules must be positioned at an optimal tilt angle (OTA) to maximize the absorption of solar radiations.

pmc-11651970.title: The value of contrast-enhanced energy-spectrum mammography combined with clinical indicators in detecting breast cancer in Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) 4 lesions
pmc-11651970.creator: Yijing Zhou, Yufeng Li, Yue Liu, Mingge Zhou, Bao Liu
pmc-11651970.description: BackgroundUnder the Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS), category 4 lesions have a high probability of malignancy. This study sought to investigate the efficacy of a model that combined the BI-RADS score with the enhancement score and clinical indicators in the diagnosis of BI-RADS 4 lesions based on contrast-enhanced spectral mammography (CESM) in breast cancer patients.

pmc-11659332.title: Consensus Statement: Recommendations on Actionable Biomarker Testing for Thyroid Cancer Management
pmc-11659332.creator: Ozgur Mete, Andrée Boucher, Kasmintan A Schrader, Omar Abdel-Rahman, Houda Bahig, Cheryl Ho, Olfat Kamel Hasan, Bernard Lemieux, Eric Winquist, Ralph Wong, Jonn Wu, Nicole Chau, Shereen Ezzat
pmc-11659332.description: Thyroid cancer management is rapidly changing. The identification of actionable biomarkers through both germline and somatic testing are now an integral part of directing patient management. However, deficiencies and disparities within existing thyroid cancer biomarker test approaches are resulting in inconsistent application for patient care.

pmc-12867189.title: Modified Colonna Capsular Arthroplasty Procedure to Treat Neglected Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip
pmc-12867189.creator: Kaveh Gharanizadeh, Hadi Ravanbod, Ahmad Hassan, Amin Nemati, Mohammad Shahsavan
pmc-12867189.description: Background:The management of neglected developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in adolescents and young adults presents a significant challenge. This study aimed to assess the clinical and radiological outcomes of the modified Colonna capsular arthroplasty technique in patients with neglected DDH.

pmc-13220437.title: Combining ultrastructure expansion microscopy with immunofluorescence and Oligopaint DNA FISH
pmc-13220437.creator: Lorielle M Raab, Clio B Hockens, Ling Sze Lee, Rose K Runyan, Emma E Burns, Nasser M Rusan, Leah F Rosin
pmc-13220437.description: Expansion microscopy (ExM) enlarges biological samples by embedding them in a swellable hydrogel, enabling nanoscale imaging of subcellular structures with standard light microscopes. This offers an accessible alternative to super-resolution methods. ExM has yet to be combined with the Oligopaint DNA fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) technology.

pmc-13356398.title: The Oocyte/Antral Follicle Count Index: Does Maximizing Oocyte Yield Translate Into Better Assisted Reproductive Technology Outcomes?
pmc-13356398.creator: Shir Danieli‐Gruber, Onit Sapir, Dan Netanely, Avital Wertheimer, Avi Ben‐Haroush, Eran Altman, Tzippy Shochat, Yoel Shufaro
pmc-13356398.description: ObjectivesWhether aspiration of more oocytes than the antral follicle count (AFC) is beneficial for the current and future products of assisted reproductive technologies (ART) cycles.MethodsData of the first oocyte aspiration for intracytoplasmic sperm injection performed between 2018 and 2022 in attempt to conceive (ICSI, n = 399) or for planned oocyte vitrification (fertility preservation [FP], n = 283) was retrieved.

pmc-13385310.title: CircLRIG1 inhibits the malignant phenotypes of colorectal cancer cells by inactivating the NF-κB signaling through interaction with FUS
pmc-13385310.creator: Qi Liu, Pei Chen, Lei Liu, Menghui Wang, Zhenjia Li
pmc-13385310.description: BackgroundCircLRIG1 has been demonstrated to inhibit the progression of bladder cancer. However, the expression profile and function of circLRIG1 in colorectal cancer (CRC), the third most prevalent malignancy globally, remain to be explored.MethodsCircLRIG1 (circBase ID: hsa_circ_0003266) expression was first analyzed in the GSE142837 dataset and subsequently validated in CRC tissues and cell lines.

pmc-13492416.title: Successful isolation of arrhythmogenic superior vena cava via balloon-in-basket pulsed field ablation: Overcoming phrenic nerve proximity
pmc-13492416.creator: Dimitrios Gerontitis, Dimitrios Katsaras, Vassiliki Tsonona, Evangelia Christoforatou, Apostolos Katsivas, Panagiotis Ioannidis
pmc-13492416.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). al contact and effective elimination of the primary arrhythmic driver.•The tissue-selective nature of pulsed field ablation, combined with high-resolution 3-dimensional mapping, allowed for successful treatment, while preserving the functional integrity of the adjacent phrenic nerve and sinus node.•The procedure was efficiently performed under conscious sedation using midazolam, demonstrating that the system’s unique pulse waveform is well tolerated and enables safe ablation within high-risk anatomic zones.

pmc-13569211.creator: Isaac Carrasco, Josep Homedes, Antonio Arcas, Shea Beasley, Marta Salichs

pmc-13700296.title: ZNF556 serves as an immunological and prognostic biomarker in colon adenocacinoma
pmc-13700296.creator: Cheng Huang, Shidong Feng, Hui Yi, Wenqian Tao, Yue Li, Zhiwei Liao
pmc-13700296.description: ObjectivesColon adenocarcinoma (COAD) is one of the most common and deadliest digestive tract malignancies, but its diagnostic and prognostic markers still need further exploration as targets for risk stratification and treatment response.MethodsCOAD cohorts were retrieved from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) databases.
